name: NBA 2K26
author: SoftwareZen
description: Auto green, auto fadeaway, dribble god combos, speed boost, auto steal/block, post moves, quick stop, and auto rebound for NBA 2K26.

mods.name: Auto Green / Perfect Release
mods.description: Automatically releases the shoot button at the exact green window based on your jumpshot timing. Detects standstill, moving, pull-up, and fadeaway shots.

mods.name: Adaptive Shot Timing
mods.description: Automatically adjusts the shot release window based on your movement state — standstill, pull-up, fadeaway, or contested. Required for Auto Green to auto-detect.

mods.name: Auto Fadeaway
mods.description: Dedicated fadeaway timing override. Left stick pulled back + shoot triggers extended hold for fade animations.

mods.name: Dribble God
mods.description: One-button dribble move combos — momentum crossover, behind the back, spin move, step-back, and size-up hesitation.

mods.name: Speed Boost / Burst
mods.description: Animation-cancel speed burst on LS click while sprinting forward.

mods.name: Auto Steal
mods.description: Rapid steal button spam while holding LT (intense defense).

mods.name: Auto Block
mods.description: Perfectly timed block attempts while in defensive stance (LT held).

mods.name: Post Move Combos
mods.description: One-button drop step, post spin, and up-and-under while in the post (LT held).

mods.name: Quick Stop Pull-Up
mods.description: Instant transition from sprint to pull-up jumper when shooting while sprinting.

mods.name: Auto Rebound
mods.description: Timed jump for rebounds when near the paint in defensive stance.
